text:
mia: Noticed a small but reproducible spike in mTLS handshake failures from eu-west-1 gateways starting ~09:10 UTC. Affects a subset of edge hosts behind envoy. Logs show 'tls: no suitable certificate' and some 502s.

mia: Quick log snippet: 
```
[09:12:03] proxy[europe-1-gw-22]: tls handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate
[09:12:04] acme-provisioner: ERROR decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111:key/abcd
```

ajay: We pushed RBAC change to remove legacy service account `acme-provisioner@legacy` from KMS decrypt binding during the staged cleanup at 09:00. That was scoped to staging but looks like the ACME instance in eu was still using it. :grimacing:

lina: Also rolled TLS min-version enforcement (tls_min: "1.3") and tightened ciphers on envoy via ConfigMap rollout at 08:55. Canary passed in us-west only.

sam: Putting two things together: if the provisioner can't decrypt private keys, proxies may serve stale certs or not complete SNI cert selection -> some clients see handshake failures when client offers older cipher suites.

ops-bot: Alert: gateway-eu handshake-failures rate > 2% (09:10-09:20). Pager: @jordan-oncall. Incident ID: INC-2026-0618-01.

jordan-oncall: Acknowledging. Mia, can you confirm customer impact? Any 5xx spikes exposed in public endpoints?

mia: There was a 1.8% increase in 502 responses on the public API egress through those nodes for ~12min. No major customer reports yet but some internal health checks failed.

lina: Rolling back tls_min change would be noisy; prefer to first re-grant KMS decrypt for the provisioning principal so cert rotation resumes. Rolling RBAC fix now to unblock.

ajay: Agreed. I'll re-add the scoped decrypt permission for `acme-provisioner@legacy` on the specific key used for eu certs with a 1hr temporary grant and audit log enabled. Command: 
```
aws kms put-key-policy --key-id alias/eu-edge-certs --policy file://grant-acme-provisioner.json --region eu-west-1
```
Make sure policy contains only `kms:Decrypt` and `kms:GenerateDataKey` for that principal.

mia: Please also capture CloudTrail/Audit logs for the deny events so we can show timeline in postmortem. Need both KMS and IAM logs.

ajay: Will do. I see the deny entries already in CloudTrail: `eventName=Decrypt`, `errorCode=AccessDenied`. I'll export a 1h snippet.

security-bot: Reminder: when re-granting, add an explicit condition `aws:RequestTag/rotator=true` and set TTL on the role binding. Also enable key rotation events export to org-logging-bucket.

sam: After we regrant, we should watch for cert churn and validate that envoy picks new certs. Suggested check: `openssl s_client -connect <gateway>:443 -servername <host> -cipher TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256` to verify handshake completes.

lina: Doing the RBAC patch now. Patch diff summarized: removed legacy principal -> added temporary binding back with conditions. Pushing in 2m.

ajay: Patch applied at 09:22 UTC. KMS errors drop-off at 09:24 according to CloudTrail.

mia: Confirmed: ACME logs show successful decrypt and CSR signing at 09:25. 502 rate back to baseline by 09:28.

jordan-oncall: Good. Can we get an action item list for postmortem and permanent fix?

lina: Action items I have:
- Add canary gating so KMS/RBAC cleanups apply to a single region first.
- Update envoy rollouts to require a pass on cert issuance checks (synthetic cert renewal) before tls_min enforcement.
- Add unit tests for ACME service account detection in our deploy jobs.

ajay: From my side:
- Harden key policy change playbook with automatic audit export and a dry-run mode.
- Provide scoped short-lived grants via STS for rotator processes rather than long-lived principals.

mia: Security postmortem notes: include timeline, denied events, and evidence that change was intended but the principal was overlooked in eu canary.

security-bot: Also add: ensure KMS CloudWatch metric `DecryptFailures` has an alert at lower threshold during rollouts.

sam: Will follow up with a small probe job to simulate cert renewal and handshake tests across regions pre-rollout. PR incoming.

jordan-oncall: Closing incident cautiously. Please add all logs + policy diffs to the incident ticket and @ops oncall will mark resolved when artifacts are attached. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

mia: attaching pasted artifacts to INC-2026-0618-01.

lina: Creating a short runbook snippet for future:
```
1) Verify no active provisioner principals in target region: `kubectl get sa -n cert-system`
2) Dry-run KMS policy change with condition `aws:RequestTag/test=true`
3) Push canary to single gateway, run synthetic renewals for 15m
4) Monitor DecryptFailures and 5xx rates
```

mia: Nice. We'll also add a checklist to the RBAC PR template.

ajay: PR: https://git.redwood/sh/restrict-kms-legacy-principal (draft)

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0618-01 status: mitigated -> awaiting artifacts.

security-bot: Recommended CSP: rotate RSA keys to ECDSA where possible for edge certs, but schedule separately.

mia: Thanks all. Follow ups scheduled in the incident ticket.
